claim: Published arm-level margins do not uniquely determine the conditional (stratum-specific) risk difference
evidence: algebra + LP on 2x2x2 model (4 latent probabilities; margins give ≤2+K equations)
required_assumptions: binary stratum/binary outcome/2 arms; known P(X=1) or arm-specific prevalences
limits: only this model class; not a statement about other designs

claim: The sharp bounds on conditional RD are the LP optima over the margin-compatible polytope
evidence: objective linear in 4 vars; constraints linear equalities + [0
required_assumptions: 1] bounds; HiGHS solves exactly; LP-vs-algebra agreement to 1e-8 in tests; coarse enumeration sign agreement
limits: margins treated as exact (no sampling error)
manuscript_location: identification bounds — not confidence intervals; sampling uncertainty is a separate layer (Imbens-Manski 2004 cited

claim: INFEASIBLE, UNSUPPORTED and REVERSIBLE are distinct states and the implementation keeps them disjoint
evidence: code paths verified: LP status 2 → INFEASIBLE; missing prevalence/mixing or solver failure → UNSUPPORTED; straddling bounds → REVERSIBLE; tests assert each

claim: On RECOVERY aggregate counts, pooled-other-subgroup borrowing would have predicted benefit (RR 0.835) where the actual no-O2 estimate shows harm (1.267)
evidence: reproduced from built-in verified counts (PMC7383595 provenance); borrow_check output recorded
limits: demonstration of risk under unexamined pooling — not prospective validation of a borrowing method

claim: RECOVERY subgroup margins leave the no-O2 decision REVERSIBLE (bounds approx [-1.00, +0.96] at q≈0.15)
evidence: CLI audit output on built-in data; logged JSON
required_assumptions: margins exact; q from arm counts
limits: wide because target stratum is a minority; result is about identifiability

claim: An arm×stratum outcome cross-tabulation resolves the bounds structurally (feasible set → point)
evidence: 2 additional equations pin all 4 latent probs for binary x
required_assumptions: table must actually be produced; values unknown a priori
limits: structural claim only — post-information decision still depends on the cells; never stated as guaranteed resolution

claim: Augmentation suggestions are cost-ordered: re-tabulation < new measurement < new enrollment < abstain
evidence: catalog ordering in code; each option's classification + assumption surfaced
limits: ordering is a heuristic burden ranking; no minimum-n claims; abstain is an output not a failure

claim: The package reproduces crude published effect estimates (RR/RD/OR) for the three datasets
evidence: tests: |RR-0.708|<0.005 RECOVERY IMV; RR 0.767 ISIS-2 SK; RD -0.0523 combo; crude OR≈0.66 REACT
limits: crude ≠ adjusted; REACT's headline OR is model-based and is labelled as such

claim: IONE does not recommend treatment and does not establish external validity
evidence: by design: verdict is about model-set agreement

claim: Sampling error is not modeled; bounds apply to the published margins as if exact
limits: under-acknowledged limitation; paper states it and cites Imbens-Manski for the inference layer
